transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’m here because nothing really feels like mine anymore. Stuff I used to care about—murals, running, basketball, even making a good drink at work—I just kind of stand there now like I don’t care about any of it.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About two months, I guess. Since the bar got bought out and everything I’d been working toward just… got changed.
Do you still enjoy things you used to like, or has the pleasure gone away too?

Yeah… the pleasure’s pretty much gone. I used to get into painting murals, going for runs, playing basketball… even just making a good drink at work. Now I mostly just stand there and don’t feel much about any of it.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
I don’t know… sad, exactly. More just kind of empty most of the time. Like I’m there, but not really in it.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or enjoy doing?
Not really. I mean… I used to get something out of murals, running, basketball, even making a good drink. Now I just kind of stand there like I don’t care about any of it.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?

I haven’t really weighed myself. I just… most days I forget to eat until my hands start shaking at work. Then maybe after closing I’ll grab a few bites of something cold, but even looking at it kind of turns my stomach.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yeah. I’m tired, but when I lie down my head won’t shut up… just going over every mistake I made at work. Then if I do fall asleep, I’m up around four or five and that’s it. Can’t really get back to sleep.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to or have trouble sitting still?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed. Maybe I’m just tired. I don’t think I’m pacing around or anything.
Do you often feel guilty about things?
Yeah… I do. I keep thinking I let people down. The younger bartenders, some artists I told I’d make room for… feels like I wrecked their chance. Like I kind of deserve whatever comes from that.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself?
I… I don’t know. I try not to think about stuff like that. I’m not really sure how to answer.
Have you ever thought that you'd be better off dead?
I’m… not sure. Sometimes I feel like things would be easier if I wasn’t around, but I don’t really know. I don’t like saying it.
Have you experienced any periods of feeling worse than you do now over the past two months?
I’m not sure… it’s kind of all blurred together. Some days are worse, I guess, but I haven’t really kept track.
Have you experienced any strange thoughts or heard any voices that others couldn't hear?

I don’t hear voices, no… not like that. But I do get these thoughts I can’t shake. Like… the bar going bad, people keep saying the owners already had plans, but I keep feeling like I poisoned it somehow. Like my ideas ruined the place, and now everyone’s paying for it because of me.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to?
I don’t know… maybe a little. I haven’t really been paying attention to that.
Have you had any days in the past two months where you felt somewhat better than you do now?
Maybe… I don’t know. There might’ve been a day here or there where it felt a little lighter, but not enough that I really noticed.
Do you find yourself fidgeting or restless when you're sitting or lying down?
Not really sure. I mean… I shift around sometimes, but I don’t know if it’s more than anyone else. I haven’t noticed it much.
Do you find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless when you're sitting still?
I mean… not that I’ve really noticed. I might shift around a bit, but I wouldn’t say I feel restless exactly.
Have you had any periods where you felt nearly normal in the past two months?
No… not really. It’s been like this for about two months, I guess. Since the bar got bought out and everything I’d been working toward kind of changed.
Do you find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless when you're sitting still?
I don’t think so. I know you asked, but… I just haven’t really noticed myself doing that. Maybe I move around some, but not like I’m restless.
Have you experienced any thoughts that you think aren't true but can't shake, like the thought that you poisoned the bar?

Yeah… I mean, people keep saying the owners already had their plans, that it wasn’t me. But I can’t really shake it. It feels like I poisoned the place somehow… like my ideas ruined the bar, and now everybody’s paying for it because of me.
